name: Service Category Totals 8
definition: Specifies totals related to the invoice.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique identification of a securities account or cash account belonging to billed customer.

ParentAccountIdentification.name: Parent Account Identification
ParentAccountIdentification.definition: Unique identification of a securities parent account or cash parent account belonging to billed customer, when reporting on sub-accounts.

BilledCustomerIdentification.name: Billed Customer Identification
BilledCustomerIdentification.definition: Identification of the customer which is invoiced.

TotalInvoiceAmount.name: Total Invoice Amount
TotalInvoiceAmount.definition: Total amount of the invoice, being the sum of total invoice lines amounts, total invoice adjustment amount (discounts, allowances and charges) and total tax amounts.

ServiceCategory.name: Service Category
ServiceCategory.definition: Agreement under which or rules under which the transaction should be processed.
